 ==== PM4ADDA.B
 
-TODO: Add missing PM4ADDA.B
+===== Encoding
+
+PM4ADDA.B is encoded in the OP-32 major opcode with packed byte elements.
+
+[wavedrom, ,svg]
+....
+{reg:[
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x3b, attr: ['OP-32'] },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rd' },
+    { bits: 3, name: 0x5 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs2' },
+    { bits: 2, name: 0x2 },
+    { bits: 4, name: 0x1, attr: ['PM4ADDA.B'] },
+    { bits: 1, name: 0x1 },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+s1 = X[rs1]
+s2 = X[rs2]
+d = X[rd]
+
+for i = 0 .. (XLEN/32 - 1):
+    // Extract four byte elements from each 32-bit group
+    s1_b0 = s1[(i*32+7):(i*32)]
+    s1_b1 = s1[(i*32+15):(i*32+8)]
+    s1_b2 = s1[(i*32+23):(i*32+16)]
+    s1_b3 = s1[(i*32+31):(i*32+24)]
+    s2_b0 = s2[(i*32+7):(i*32)]
+    s2_b1 = s2[(i*32+15):(i*32+8)]
+    s2_b2 = s2[(i*32+23):(i*32+16)]
+    s2_b3 = s2[(i*32+31):(i*32+24)]
+    d_w = d[(i*32+31):(i*32)]
+    // Multiply four byte pairs, sum products, and accumulate
+    d[(i*32+31):(i*32)] = d_w
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b0) * signed(s2_b0))
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b1) * signed(s2_b1))
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b2) * signed(s2_b2))
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b3) * signed(s2_b3))
+
+X[rd] = d
+----
+
+===== Description
+
+PM4ADDA.B multiplies four pairs of signed 8-bit byte elements from `rs1` and
+`rs2` within each 32-bit group, sums the four products, and accumulates the
+result into the corresponding 32-bit element of `rd`. This instruction is the
+accumulating variant of PM4ADD.B.

+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },

+    { bits: 1, name: 0x1 },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+s1 = X[rs1]
+s2 = X[rs2]
+d = X[rd]
+
+for i = 0 .. (XLEN/32 - 1):
+    // Extract four byte elements from each 32-bit group
+    s1_b0 = s1[(i*32+7):(i*32)]
+    s1_b1 = s1[(i*32+15):(i*32+8)]
+    s1_b2 = s1[(i*32+23):(i*32+16)]
+    s1_b3 = s1[(i*32+31):(i*32+24)]
+    s2_b0 = s2[(i*32+7):(i*32)]
+    s2_b1 = s2[(i*32+15):(i*32+8)]
+    s2_b2 = s2[(i*32+23):(i*32+16)]
+    s2_b3 = s2[(i*32+31):(i*32+24)]
+    d_w = d[(i*32+31):(i*32)]
+    // Multiply four signed*unsigned byte pairs, sum products, and accumulate
+    d[(i*32+31):(i*32)] = d_w
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b0) * unsigned(s2_b0))
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b1) * unsigned(s2_b1))
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b2) * unsigned(s2_b2))
+        + sext32(signed(s1_b3) * unsigned(s2_b3))

+----
+
+===== Description
+
+PM4ADDASU.B multiplies four pairs of byte elements from `rs1` (signed) and
+`rs2` (unsigned) within each 32-bit group, sums the four products, and
+accumulates the result into the corresponding 32-bit element of `rd`. This
+instruction is the signed-unsigned accumulating variant of PM4ADDSU.B.

 ==== PM4ADDA.H
 
-TODO: Add missing PM4ADDA.H
+===== Encoding
+
+PM4ADDA.H is encoded in the OP-32 major opcode with packed halfword elements
+(RV64 only).
+
+[wavedrom, ,svg]
+....
+{reg:[
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x3b, attr: ['OP-32'] },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rd' },
+    { bits: 3, name: 0x5 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs2' },
+    { bits: 2, name: 0x3 },
+    { bits: 4, name: 0x1, attr: ['PM4ADDA.H'] },
+    { bits: 1, name: 0x1 },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+// RV64 only
+s1 = X[rs1]
+s2 = X[rs2]
+
+// Multiply four signed 16-bit halfword pairs and accumulate sum into rd
+X[rd] = X[rd]
+      + sext64(signed(s1[15:0])   * signed(s2[15:0]))
+      + sext64(signed(s1[31:16])  * signed(s2[31:16]))
+      + sext64(signed(s1[47:32])  * signed(s2[47:32]))
+      + sext64(signed(s1[63:48])  * signed(s2[63:48]))
+----
+
+===== Description
+
+PM4ADDA.H (RV64 only) multiplies four pairs of signed 16-bit halfword elements
+from `rs1` and `rs2`, sums the four 64-bit products, and accumulates the result
+into `rd`. This instruction is the accumulating variant of PM4ADD.H.
